note: beyond10x/ess#532, docs/design/value-expressions.md section E10. Each vector binds `source` to `value` (left unbound where `value` is absent) and evaluates `{source: {trimmed: <operator>}}`. The Rust evaluator (ess-primitives tests/string_operators/trimmed_text.rs), the Go runtime and the TypeScript runtime (ess-conformance tests/string_operators/trimmed_text_guard.rs and src/ts/predicate.test.ts) answer every vector alike. The trimmed set is ASCII space, tab, LF, VT, FF and CR, and nothing else.
